title: Cloud Storage Platform
description: A Dropbox-like file hosting service offering cloud storage, file synchronization, personal cloud, and client software.

modules.name: Chunked Uploads
modules.description: Splitting large files into smaller chunks for reliable uploading and resuming.

modules.name: File Synchronization
modules.description: Desktop client integration to sync local folders with cloud storage via polling/websockets.

modules.name: Deduplication Engine
modules.description: Identifying identical files to save storage space on the backend.

modules.name: Link Sharing & Permissions
modules.description: Generating public/private links with expiration dates and passwords.

title: Serverless Function Platform
description: A miniature serverless platform allowing users to deploy and run code snippets in response to HTTP triggers.

modules.name: Code Ingestion
modules.description: API to accept user code (Node/Python) and package it.

modules.name: Container Orchestration
modules.description: Spinning up Docker containers on-demand when a function is triggered.

modules.name: API Gateway
modules.description: Routing HTTP requests to the correct running container function.

modules.name: Metering & Billing
modules.description: Tracking execution time (in milliseconds) and memory usage for billing.

title: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Dashboard
description: A web interface wrapping Terraform to allow non-technical teams to provision standardized cloud resources safely.

modules.name: Template Catalog
modules.description: Pre-approved Terraform modules (e.g., 'Standard Web Server', 'Secure Database').

modules.name: Provisioning Engine
modules.description: Executing Terraform plans and applies via backend jobs.

modules.name: State Management
modules.description: Securely storing and managing Terraform state files in S3/DynamoDB.

modules.name: Cost Estimator
modules.description: Using Infracost or AWS APIs to show projected costs before provisioning.

learning_outcomes: Integrating CLI tools with web backends

title: Multi-Cloud Billing Analyzer
description: A tool that aggregates billing data from AWS, GCP, and Azure to provide unified dashboards and cost-saving recommendations.

modules.name: Data Ingestion Pipeline
modules.description: Parsing massive Cost and Usage Reports (CUR) from cloud providers daily.

modules.name: Data Normalization
modules.description: Standardizing services (e.g., EC2 and Compute Engine mapped to 'Compute').

modules.name: Anomaly Detection
modules.description: Alerting users if daily spend spikes unexpectedly on a specific resource.

modules.name: Optimization Insights
modules.description: Identifying idle resources or recommending reserved instances.

project_objectives: Process gigabytes of billing data quickly
Identify at least 10% potential cost savings for clients

title: Database Migration Service
description: A service to replicate and migrate databases from on-premise servers to cloud managed databases with minimal downtime.

modules.name: Schema Conversion
modules.description: Translating table structures and data types between different DB engines.

modules.name: Initial Snapshot
modules.description: Efficiently transferring the bulk initial data load without locking tables.

modules.name: CDC (Change Data Capture)
modules.description: Tailing database transaction logs (e.g., binlog, WAL) to replicate ongoing changes.

modules.name: Validation Engine
modules.description: Comparing source and target databases to ensure zero data corruption.

learning_outcomes: Deep understanding of database internals and transaction logs
project_objectives: Keep replication lag under 1 second during CDC phase
